## Change

Describe the listing or tooling change and why it is needed. For an app submission or transfer, state your relationship to the app and any known compatibility or setup limitations. Link public evidence for corrections, removals, or transfers.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [code of conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] For a new listing or transfer, I maintain the app or am authorized to represent it; otherwise this item is not applicable.
- [ ] Catalog YAML and both README tables agree, or this change does not affect listings.
- [ ] Public URLs use HTTPS and contain no credentials; no registration secrets, tokens, class IDs, or private deployment details are included.
- [ ] Compatibility is described as the app author's statement; this contribution does not claim directory verification or certification.
- [ ] I ran `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm run check` successfully.

## Validation

Summarize the checks performed and any remaining limitations. For an app listing, include the public source and setup links if they help reviewers.
